$81, 748 - $114,771 per annum + 12% super & salary packaging | Permanent Full-Time and Part-Time Hours Available | Medical Imaging Service, Wollongong Hospital (TWH) | REQ676097 | Grade: Registered Nurse | Applications close: 27 July 2026

Join us in shaping healthier futures. Together we can do more.

Join the Medical Imaging team at Wollongong Hospital and play a vital role in delivering exceptional patient care across Radiology and Nuclear Medicine. Working with patients of all ages and varying clinical complexity, you'll provide care before, during and after diagnostic and interventional procedures while collaborating with a highly skilled multidisciplinary team. This is an exciting opportunity to expand your clinical expertise through supported training in areas including vascular access, contrast administration, procedural nursing, advanced life support, sedation, patient recovery and radiation safety. If you're a motivated Registered Nurse who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values teamwork and is passionate about delivering safe, patient-centred care, we'd love to hear from you.

For more information and to view the position classification, see the Position Description here.

A little about us.

Wollongong Hospital is the Illawarra Shoalhaven's major referral and teaching hospital and has a bed-base count of more than 500. The campus, which incorporates the Illawarra Regional Cancer Care Centre, provides a comprehensive range of inpatient, outpatient and community-based services.

Wollongong is located an hour's drive south of Sydney on a narrow coastal strip bordered by the Royal National Park to the north, Lake Illawarra to the south, the Tasman Sea to the east and the Illawarra Escarpment to the west. Learn more about the lifestyle benefits of living and working in Wollongong here.

Benefits of working with ISLHD.

We understand that balancing career aspirations with the demand of the everyday, as well as maintaining a healthy work-life balance, can be a challenge. To help with this, we offer a range of benefits which include:

-Allocated Days Off (ADO) - once a month take a paid day off (eligible full-time employees)

-Salary packaging- less tax and more take-home pay

-Novated leasing - lease a car and pay for all running costs out of your pre-taxed salary (eligible full-time employees)

-Fitness Passport - discounted gym membership that both you and your family can enjoy (eligible employees)

-Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - free confidential and professional assistance for staff and their families

-Career progression, professional development and secondment opportunities

Apply now by reading the Position Description, then, using our online portal, submit a resume and answer the selection criteriawithin the application. In addition, please note you must have the following essential requirements:

-Applicable vaccination requirements for a Category Arole.

-Working With Children Check (WWCC)

-Current AHPRA Registration

ISLHD is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

ISLHD is dedicated to fostering a child-safe environment that respects and upholds the rights of children and young people, aligned with NSW Health's commitment to implementing the Child Safe Standards. We aim to ensure that children and young people feel safe, supported, and included in their care. All current and prospective staff are expected to prioritise the safety, welfare, and wellbeing of children and young people, actively working to protect them from harm and abuse.

Need more information or help applying?

-Visit the ISLHD website for application tips, to learn more about ISLHDandother important application information.

-Visit the Stepping Up website here. Stepping Up supports Aboriginal people to navigate the recruitment process and find a career or employment in NSW Health.

-Follow us on social media: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedInand YouTube.

-For role-related queries or help applying, contact Tessa Nolan at Tessa.Nolan@health.nsw.gov.au

* Salary: $70,000 – $80,000 per year (depending on experience)

* Work Authorisation: Australian citizens and permanent residents preferred (visa sponsorship available for suitable candidates)

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Indian Chef to join our catering team. The successful applicant must have a minimum of two years’ experience preparing authentic Indian cuisine in a commercial kitchen, with experience in high-volume catering or function service preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and cook authentic Indian cuisine for weddings, corporate events, private functions, and outdoor catering.
* Prepare ingredients, sauces, marinades, and other food items to ensure efficient service.
* Assist with menu planning and the preparation of catering menus.
* Ensure food quality, consistency, and presentation meet company standards.
* Maintain food safety, cleanliness, and hygiene in accordance with health regulations.
* Train and supervise cooks and kitchen staff where required.
* Assist with stock control, food preparation planning, and minimising food wastage.
* Work collaboratively with the catering team to ensure the timely preparation and delivery of food for events.

Requirements

* Minimum two years’ experience as an Indian Chef.
* Strong knowledge of authentic Indian cuisine and cooking techniques.
* Experience preparing food for catering events or function centres is highly desirable.
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen environment.
* Strong organisational and time management skills.
* Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits

* Free meals
* Free drinks
* Visa sponsorship available for suitable candidates
* Overtime pay
